crossRefs.note: You were in Eden, the garden of God. Every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz, emerald, chrysolite, onyx, jasper…
Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and…
You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are…
Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?
Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you…
The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
Then I will cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth and the…
For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in…
Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice…
I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.
Who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves…
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of…
The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no…

translations.web: I will cause the noise of your songs to cease. The sound of your harps won’t be heard any more.
translations.bsb: So I will silence the sound of your songs, and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard.
translations.kjv: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
translations.asv: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
